data_audit.limits: Within-repository independent source/value reconstruction,not model execution,external replication,pretraining novelty or a diagnostic-model release.

correctness.arithmetic_error: An executable generated equation is false, or a fully parsed trace ends with a numeric value different from the prefix-derived root.
correctness.limits: Canonical execution is a conservative verified subset, not a universal correctness judge. Exact root equality alone does not establish faithful computation.
correctness.other: All remaining outputs, including valid alternative procedures, are reported separately and are not silently called incorrect.
correctness.verified_canonical: Every nonempty generated line is exactly one bounded numeric equation; ordered left-expression ASTs match the prefix-derived postorder trace, right values are exact and all equations are true. Whitespace, redundant parentheses and equivalent rational literal spellings are ignored.

data.limits: Supervised future-RHS curation, not pretraining novelty or independent held-out confirmation. No model outcome enters selection.
data.selection: Sort by SHA256('v30-fixed-cohort:' + item_id); first8 engineering qualification, next256 diagnostic; remaining126 unused.
data.source: Pinned FineMath TRAIN shard61, source/page/content/ordered-AST disjoint from retained prior training and development sources.

decision.alignment: At least32 documents contain both a verified-canonical sample and an arithmetic-error sample. Within each such document compare mean full16 reward of those two classes; overall mean difference at least0.25nats and positive paired95 lower bound. Report this conditional population explicitly.
decision.complete_execution: All256 documents,9 candidate attempts per document,14 frozen-reader scores per document and B0 raw score required. Errors/unsupported/caps retained; no pass from incomplete outputs.
decision.correct_helpful_coverage: At least64 documents contain a verified-canonical sample that beats BOTH raw baselines on full16. Report exact count and document-bootstrap interval.
decision.negative: If any requirement fails or alignment is unidentifiable at these fixed settings, do not launch RL under this reward. Close this reward branch until a materially different mechanism is proposed. Do not temperature/prompt/checkpoint sweep to repair this result.
decision.numerical_only: A numeral gain that loses on the full continuation cannot pass.
decision.opportunity: Best-of8 full16 gain versus same-reader raw, B0 raw, and greedy must each have mean at least0.25nats and positive paired95 lower bound.
decision.plumbing: Oracle minus corrupted full16 score has positive paired95 lower bound.
decision.positive: Only an oracle opportunity and reward-alignment result. Best-of8 uses future scoring and is not deployable prefix-only selection. No RL or additional training is automatically released.

execution.qualification: 8 separate source documents; actual fixed-model native/cache/full-span and saved stochastic behavior-LP checks against independent HF, RNG reproducibility. No scientific result inspected before qualification.
execution.release: Freeze source and concrete one-question review after qualification/profiling. No automatic retry; retain incomplete outputs if a bound is reached.
execution.resources: Existing instance only; preserve35GiB filesystem/512GiB host-available floors, all original states and cache.

models.precision: FP32 parameters and compute, full-support FP32 likelihood. This is not BF16 rollout/training qualification.
models.writer_and_reader: Original V29 computation-seed2026102029 terminal1280, chronologically first order, checkpoint SHA bacd0f2522d5998c4b355c0f15209fcb36b5b0ddd361606e8fef89cefea714d4

policy.generation_inputs: Separate question-projection file containing only IDs and prefix tokens; no continuation/answer/trace labels.
policy.interface: Exact V29 native Calculation opening and full Answer closing; no header or re-anchor change.
policy.save: Every action, behavior log-probability, action mask, decoded text, sampled stop/cap, RNG seed, prompt hash, latency and actual decode iterations. No resampling or replacement.
policy.seed: Positive31-bit integer from first8bytes SHA256('v30-sampling:' + item_id), modulo2147483646 plus1; fixed before candidates.
policy.stopping: First native Answer-boundary token or base EOS; include sampled stop, strip it only from reader content; force the complete same Answer boundary for all conditioned scores.
policy.support: All defined tokenizer IDs, no top-k/top-p or undocumented penalties; mask undefined head rows only.

frozen_design.question: Do prefix-only candidate calculations contain correct full-continuation improvements that a frozen predictive reward can recognize?
frozen_design.scope: One bounded TRAIN-only diagnostic. No updates, RL, new CPT, model-size change, held-panel retuning, or official TEST.

scoring.boundary: Same complete forced Answer boundary for all conditioned contexts, including capped/EOS attempts; never truncate a context or target.
scoring.corrupt: Same oracle with final root value plus1; prefix-only deterministic control.
scoring.oracle: Exact prefix-derived full calculation, including root answer; privileged plumbing control.
scoring.other: Intact greedy note from next item in fixed cohort order, wraparound; never repaired or length matched.
scoring.primary: Sum log probability of all16 original continuation tokens under the same frozen reader; reward is candidate minus genuine empty-format score.

frozen_design.separate_prerequisite: Concretely investigate the regressing V29 raw-control objective, exposures and loss records before any new full CPT proposal. No new CPT currently authorized.

statistics.interval: Paired document percentile95, conditional on fixed checkpoint, cohort and sampling policy; not training-seed or model-family robustness.
statistics.limits: Small diagnostic with unadjusted component intervals and conjunctive decision, not powered confirmation or autonomous learned selection.
statistics.unit: 256 unique source documents, not2048 candidate draws

limits: Data and CPU checks are not a capability result.
One bounded TRAIN-only diagnostic; no new learning, RL or scale release.
No usable full-continuation correctness/reward relationship means close this reward branch.
